result.text: I need to stop treating “I want to be with her” as an answer to questions it doesn't answer. Do I want to raise children with her? Live with her? Build a community with her? Those need their own answers. I also want to notice when “I’m taking a chance on this person” has quietly changed into “she’s the right person.” Maybe I learned something new. Maybe I just got more attached.
